title: Critique: the ultimates have qualities but are not subjects

statements.text: The panpsychist should drop the claim that ultimates are subjects and keep the claim that they have phenomenal qualities, which then exist unexperienced. The result is a neutral monism, also called panqualityism, in which awareness of qualities is explained by representation in the brain.

sources.quote: panpsychists can maintain that the ultimates possess phenomenal qualities, despite not being subjects of those qualities
panpsychists should really be neutral monists
